newsitem.title: USA: LCI International added to S&P MidCap 400.
newsitem.headline: LCI International added to S&P MidCap 400.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said Wednesday it will replace Goulds Pumps Inc in the S&P MidCap 400 Index with LCI International Inc after the close of trading Thursday, May 22.
ITT Industries Inc is acquiring Goulds Pumps through a friendly cash tender offer and has received all regulatory approvals for the deal, which should close tomorrow as scheduled, S&P said.

LCI International, headquartered in McLean, Virginia, is a facilities-based long-distance telecommunications provider offering voice and data services to commercial, governmental, and residential customers.
S&P said the company will be added to the S&P MidCap 400 Telecommunications industry group in the Communications Services economic sector.
